instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: Okay, hi. So you see a grid in front of you. Take a blue block and with its long side facing you and place it on the two squares of the grid that are further away from you. Then take a red block and place it on the right side of the blue block. And then take another red block and place it on top of that red block.

assumptions: The blue block's 'long side facing you' refers to its default axis=x orientation, where its 4-unit dimension is parallel to the x-axis.
The phrase 'on the right side of the blue block' implies placing the red block on top of the right half of the blue block.
Stacked blocks are vertically aligned and centered on their supporting block.
evidence: Take a blue block and with its long side facing you and place it on the two squares of the grid that are further away from you.
